title: Water/Sanitary Sewer Construction Project
description: Use this service request to request information and ask questions regarding water and wastewater construction projects. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 2 business days.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request with a question about a water or sewer construction project.
actions.why: For information or questions about water or wastewater construction work. The 311 request form asks for the concern, when the work was observed, and the type of construction.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Under "Other Requests", choose "Water/Sanitary Sewer Construction Project"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Under "Other Requests", choose "Water/Sanitary Sewer Construction Project"
